name: Gather Rot Blossoms
summary: In Duskwood, Tavernkeep Smitts needs rot blossoms for his zombie juice. The plants grow inside the skulls of skeletal horrors and fiends in the graveyards.

sections.title: A Bizarre Ingredient
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts sometimes brews a strange drink at the Scarlet Raven Tavern. His recipe for zombie juice calls for rot blossoms, which root inside the empty skulls of animated skeletons. Smitts avoids the undead, so passing mercenaries gather the blossoms for him.

sections.title: Graveyard Pest Control
sections.body: Rot blossoms grow on skeletal horrors and fiends in the overgrown plots of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery and across Raven Hill Cemetery. The Night Watch militia is stretched thin fighting the woods’ creeping terrors. Smitts commends adventurers who hunt the dead to Commander Althea Ebonlocke, helping cull the restless ranks that threaten Darkshire.

aliases: where do rot blossoms come from
faq.answer: Rot blossoms are foul plants that grow in dark magic and decay. In Duskwood, they sprout inside the skulls of animated skeletal horrors and fiends.

faq.q: Why does Tavernkeep Smitts need rot blossoms?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts uses rot blossoms to brew zombie juice, a drink requested by certain patrons in the region.

faq.q: Where can the skeletons bearing these blossoms be found?
faq.answer: Skeletal horrors and fiends bearing rot blossoms haunt Duskwood’s burial grounds, especially Tranquil Gardens Cemetery near Darkshire and Raven Hill Cemetery to the west.

faq.q: Does this task help the defense of Darkshire?
faq.answer: Yes. Darkshire depends on the Night Watch to survive constant undead attacks. Hunting skeletons for the blossoms thins the monsters threatening the town and helps Commander Althea Ebonlocke.

faq.q: What comes next after delivering the blossoms?
faq.answer: After receiving the blossoms and brewing the zombie juice, Smitts asks you to deliver the draught to Abercrombie, an eccentric hermit near Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: Is zombie juice a normal beverage served in Darkshire?
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Raven Tavern usually serves regional fare. Smitts prepares zombie juice, a strange brew with necrotic ingredients, only when he receives an eccentric order.

angles.text: Rot blossoms are dark botanical growths rooted in necromantic decay and animated bone, unlike ordinary herbs that flourish in rich soil and sunlight.
As an Alliance adventurer, hunting undead in Duskwood’s cemeteries eases the Night Watch’s daily fight to keep Darkshire from falling.
